scope: Current optimized headless worker/storage fixture; excludes host routing, GUI, live models and services.
limitations: Headless worker and storage measurements exclude the native GUI and application host routing.
RSS and macOS physical footprint are point-in-time samples of the worker alone; neither proves full app plus worker attributable RAM.
Worker ready time is not application launch-to-usable time.
Tool time includes native file read, journal and JSONL delivery; it is not isolated dispatch overhead.
No live model quality, network latency, browser, generation-model weights or KV-cache measurement is claimed.
